mapper.sql:
with eccd as (select a.execute_date, a.contract_code, a.org_id, coalesce (a.amount::numeric , 0) amount from ( select execute_date, query_field::json ->>'CONTRACT_CODE' as contract_code, query_field::json ->>'ORG_ID' as org_id, query_field::json ->>'AMOUNT' as amount from eg_check_common_data where del_flag='0' and business_type = 'ysxxs' and to_char(execute_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd')=( select max(to_char(execute_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) from eg_check_common_data where business_type = 'ysxxs') ) a) , ec_t AS ( SELECT contract_code, lease_type FROM ( SELECT lease_type, contract_code, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY contract_code ORDER BY id DESC) AS rn FROM eg_contract ) AS subquery WHERE rn = 1 ) , erp as (select erp.contract_code,erp.org_id,sum(coalesce(rent_amount, 0)) as rent_amount from (select * from eg_repayment_plan erp order by erp.contract_code, erp.org_id) erp where del_flag='0' group by erp.contract_code,erp.org_id)
, tgr as ( select tax_rate/100 as tax_rate from eg_tax_rate where fund_type ='tax_general' and lease_type = '回租' and business_code ='ZLYW' and enable_flag ='1' and del_flag ='0' ), rc as ( select tax_rate/100 as tax_rate from eg_tax_rate where fund_type ='receivable_commission' and lease_type = '回租' and business_code ='ZLYW' and enable_flag ='1' and del_flag ='0' ), ri as ( select tax_rate/100 as tax_rate from eg_tax_rate where fund_type ='receivable_insurance' and lease_type = '回租' and business_code ='ZLYW' and enable_flag ='1' and del_flag ='0' ),
tgr1 as ( select tax_rate/100 as tax_rate from eg_tax_rate where fund_type ='tax_general' and lease_type = '直租' and business_code ='ZLYW' and enable_flag ='1' and del_flag ='0' ), rc1 as ( select tax_rate/100 as tax_rate from eg_tax_rate where fund_type ='receivable_commission' and lease_type = '直租' and business_code ='ZLYW' and enable_flag ='1' and del_flag ='0' ), ri1 as ( select tax_rate/100 as tax_rate from eg_tax_rate where fund_type ='receivable_insurance' and lease_type = '直租' and business_code ='ZLYW' and enable_flag ='1' and del_flag ='0' ) , tp as ( select ec.contract_code , ec.org_id , case when ec.lease_type = '回租' and ec.system_code not in ('CYCXT', 'SYCXT') then (coalesce (erp.rent_amount,0) + coalesce (receivable_first_amount, 0)+ coalesce (retained_price, 0) -coalesce (payable_device_amount, 0))/(1+tgr.tax_rate)*tgr.tax_rate +coalesce (receivable_procedure_amount, 0)/(1+rc.tax_rate)+rc.tax_rate +coalesce (receivable_insurance_amount, 0)/(1+ri.tax_rate)+ri.tax_rate when ec.lease_type = '回租' and ec.system_code in ('CYCXT', 'SYCXT') then (coalesce (erp.rent_amount,0) + coalesce (receivable_first_amount, 0)+ coalesce (retained_price, 0) -coalesce (payable_device_amount, 0))/(1+tgr.tax_rate)*tgr.tax_rate +coalesce (receivable_procedure_amount, 0)/(1+rc.tax_rate)+rc.tax_rate when ec.lease_type = '直租' and ec.system_code not in ('CYCXT', 'SYCXT') then (coalesce (erp.rent_amount,0) + coalesce (receivable_first_amount, 0) + coalesce (retained_price, 0))/(1+tgr1.tax_rate)*tgr1.tax_rate +coalesce (receivable_procedure_amount, 0)/(1+rc1.tax_rate)+rc1.tax_rate +coalesce (receivable_insurance_amount, 0)/(1+ri1.tax_rate)+ri1.tax_rate when ec.lease_type = '直租' and ec.system_code in ('CYCXT', 'SYCXT') then (coalesce (erp.rent_amount,0) + coalesce (receivable_first_amount, 0) + coalesce (retained_price, 0))/(1+tgr1.tax_rate)*tgr1.tax_rate +coalesce (receivable_procedure_amount, 0)/(1+rc1.tax_rate)+rc1.tax_rate else 0 end tax_payable from eg_contract ec left join erp on erp.contract_code = ec.contract_code and erp.org_id = ec.org_id left join tgr on 1=1 left join rc on 1=1 left join ri on 1=1 left join tgr1 on 1=1 left join rc1 on 1=1 left join ri1 on 1=1 ) , erp_t AS ( SELECT contract_code, org_id, service_fee_received, actual_repayment_date FROM ( SELECT service_fee_received, actual_repayment_date::TIMESTAMP, contract_code, org_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY contract_code,org_id ORDER BY id DESC) AS rn FROM eg_repayment_plan ) AS t WHERE rn = 1 )
mapper.select: with contract as ( select ec.contract_code,ec.contract_code_m ,'租赁' as contract_type, ec.org_id, ecm.lease_date_start ,ec.lease_type, ec.tax_rate, ec.client_code , ec.client_name, ec.invoicing_flag, ecm.contract_status, ec.financial_contract_status, ec.actual_service_amount, ecm.lease_date_end from eg_contract ec left join eg_contract_month ecm on ec.id = ecm.id where ec.del_flag = '0' and (ec.contract_code = ec.contract_code_m or ec.contract_code_m is null or ec.contract_code_m = '') union all select ec.contract_code,ec.contract_code_m ,'服务费' as contract_type, ec.org_id, ecm.lease_date_start ,ec.lease_type, ec.tax_rate, ec.client_code , ec.client_name, ec.invoicing_flag, ecm.contract_status, ec.financial_contract_status, ec.actual_service_amount, ecm.lease_date_end from eg_contract ec left join eg_contract_month ecm on ec.id = ecm.id where ec.del_flag = '0' and (ec.contract_code_m is not null or ec.contract_code_m = '') ), tax as ( select coalesce (tr.tax_rate, contract.tax_rate)/100 as taxRate, tr.lease_type, contract.contract_code, contract.org_id, contract.contract_type from eg_tax_rate tr inner join contract on contract.lease_type = tr.lease_type where tr.del_flag = '0' and tr.business_code='ZLYW' and tr.fund_type='tax_general' ), rp as ( select repayment.contract_code, repayment.org_id, repayment.amount / (1+coalesce(tax.taxRate, 0)) * coalesce(tax.taxRate, 1) as rpAmount from ( select erp.contract_code, erp.org_id, sum(coalesce(rent_amount, 0)) - sum(coalesce(actual_repayment_principal_amount, 0)) - sum(coalesce(actual_repayment_interes_amount, 0)) as amount from eg_repayment_plan erp group by erp.contract_code , erp.org_id ) repayment left join tax on repayment.contract_code = tax.contract_code and repayment.org_id = tax.org_id and tax.contract_type='租赁' ), cbm as ( select contract_code , org_id , sum(coalesce (receivable_outtax_balance, 0)) as receivable_outtax_balance_sum, sum(coalesce (receive_sum_outtax_balance, 0)) as receive_sum_outtax_balance_sum, sum(coalesce(receivable_service_outtax_balance, 0)) as receivable_service_outtax_balance_sum from eg_contract_balance_month where period_code = '202502' group by contract_code , org_id ), ve1 as ( select eve.contract_code , ev.org_id , sum(coalesce (credit_amount, 0)) as camount from eg_voucher_entry eve inner join eg_voucher ev on ev.id = eve.voucher_id and eve.del_flag ='0' where eve.period_code>202502 and eve.period_code<=#{queryPeriodCode} and ev.scene_code in ('HTQZ','HTCX','JYJGBG','ZLSK','SGPZ', 'RKSH', 'CWRK') and ev.valid_flag='1' and ev.voucher_status in('2','3','4') and eve.del_flag ='0' and eve.account_code = '1122.07' group by eve.contract_code , ev.org_id ), ve2 as ( select eve.contract_code , ev.org_id , sum(coalesce (credit_amount, 0)) as camount from eg_voucher_entry eve inner join eg_voucher ev on ev.id = eve.voucher_id and eve.del_flag ='0' where eve.period_code>202502 and eve.period_code<=#{queryPeriodCode} and ev.scene_code in ('HTQZ','HTCX','JYJGBG','ZLSK','SGPZ', 'RKSH', 'CWRK') and ev.valid_flag='1' and ev.voucher_status in('2','3','4') and eve.del_flag ='0' and eve.account_code in ('1531.01.09','1505.03.03') group by eve.contract_code , ev.org_id ), ve3 as ( select eve.contract_code , ev.org_id , sum(coalesce (debit_amount, 0)) as camount from eg_voucher_entry eve inner join eg_voucher ev on ev.id = eve.voucher_id and eve.del_flag ='0' where eve.period_code > 202502 and eve.period_code<=#{queryPeriodCode} and ev.scene_code in ('ZLSK','WCTZ','SGPZ') and ev.valid_flag='1' and ev.voucher_status in('2','3','4') and eve.del_flag ='0' and eve.account_code = '1122.07' group by eve.contract_code , ev.org_id ), ve4 as ( select eve.contract_code , ev.org_id , sum(coalesce (debit_amount, 0)) as camount from eg_voucher_entry eve inner join eg_voucher ev on ev.id = eve.voucher_id and eve.del_flag ='0' where eve.period_code > 202502 and eve.period_code<=#{queryPeriodCode} and ev.scene_code in ('ZLSK','WCTZ', 'SGPZ') and ev.valid_flag='1' and ev.voucher_status in('2','3','4') and eve.del_flag ='0' and eve.account_code in ('1531.01.09','1505.03.03') group by eve.contract_code , ev.org_id ), ve5 as ( select eve.contract_code , ev.org_id , sum(coalesce (debit_amount, 0)) as camount from eg_voucher_entry eve inner join eg_voucher ev on ev.id = eve.voucher_id and eve.del_flag ='0' where eve.period_code > 202502 and eve.period_code<=#{queryPeriodCode} and ev.scene_code ='KJFP' and ev.valid_flag='1' and ev.voucher_status in('2','3','4') and eve.del_flag ='0' and eve.account_code = '1122.07' group by eve.contract_code , ev.org_id ), ve6 as ( select eve.contract_code , ev.org_id , sum(coalesce (debit_amount, 0)) as camount from eg_voucher_entry eve inner join eg_voucher ev on ev.id = eve.voucher_id and eve.del_flag ='0' where eve.period_code > 202502 and eve.period_code<= #{queryPeriodCode} and ev.scene_code ='KJFP' and ev.valid_flag='1' and ev.voucher_status in('2','3','4') and eve.del_flag ='0' and eve.account_code in ('1531.01.09','1505.03.03') group by eve.contract_code , ev.org_id ), ro as ( select t.contract_code, t.org_id, sum(coalesce(t.receivable_service_outtax_balance_sum, 0)) as receivable_service_outtax_balance_sum, sum(coalesce(t.receivable_outtax_balance_sum, 0)) as receivable_outtax_balance_sum, sum(coalesce(t.receive_sum_outtax_balance_sum, 0)) as receive_sum_outtax_balance_sum, sum(coalesce(t.receivable_residual_value_balance_sum, 0)) as receivable_residual_value_balance_sum from (select contract_code, org_id, coalesce(receivable_service_outtax_amount, 0) as receivable_service_outtax_balance_sum, coalesce(receivable_outtax_amount, 0) as receivable_outtax_balance_sum, coalesce(receive_sum_outtax_amount, 0) as receive_sum_outtax_balance_sum, coalesce(receivable_residual_value_amount, 0) as receivable_residual_value_balance_sum from eg_contract_balance where period_code = #{queryPeriodCode} and del_flag = '0' union all select contract_code, org_id, coalesce(receivable_service_outtax_balance, 0) as receivable_service_outtax_balance_sum, coalesce(receivable_outtax_balance, 0) as receivable_outtax_balance_sum, coalesce(receive_sum_outtax_balance, 0) as receive_sum_outtax_balance_sum, coalesce(receivable_residual_value_balance, 0) as receivable_residual_value_balance_sum from eg_contract_balance_month where period_code = #{queryPeriodCode} -1 and del_flag = '0') t group by t.contract_code, t.org_id ), rbl as ( select contract_code, org_id, coalesce(report_balance, 0) as report_balance, amount_type from eg_report_balance where contract_code is not null and contract_code != '' and to_char(invoicing_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') = #{reportDate} ), tp as ( select contract.contract_code, contract.org_id, contract.contract_type, tax.taxRate, case when contract.lease_date_start <= '2025-02-28' and contract.contract_type ='租赁' then coalesce(cbm.receivable_outtax_balance_sum,0) * -1 + coalesce(cbm.receive_sum_outtax_balance_sum,0) + coalesce (ve2.camount,0) when contract.lease_date_start <= '2025-02-28' and contract.contract_type ='服务费' then coalesce(cbm.receivable_service_outtax_balance_sum,0) * -1 + coalesce (ve1.camount,0) when contract.lease_date_start > '2025-02-28' and contract.contract_type ='服务费' then coalesce(ve1.camount,0) when contract.lease_date_start > '2025-02-28' and contract.contract_type ='租赁' then coalesce(ve2.camount,0) end as taxPayable, case when contract.contract_type ='服务费' then ve3.camount when contract.contract_type ='租赁' then ve4.camount end as taxAccrued, case when contract.contract_type ='服务费' then ve5.camount when contract.contract_type ='租赁' then ve6.camount end as taxInvoiced, case when contract.contract_type ='服务费' then 0 when contract.contract_type ='租赁' then rp.rpAmount end as shouldTaxBalance, case when contract.contract_type ='服务费' then ro.receivable_service_outtax_balance_sum when contract.contract_type ='租赁' then ro.receivable_outtax_balance_sum + ro.receive_sum_outtax_balance_sum end as accountBalance, case when contract.contract_type ='服务费' then actual_service_amount when contract.contract_type ='租赁' then 0 end as serviceFeeReceived, case when contract.contract_type ='服务费' then 0 when contract.contract_type ='租赁' then ro.receivable_residual_value_balance_sum end as retainedPriceBalance, rbl.report_balance from contract left join cbm on contract.contract_code = cbm.contract_code and contract.org_id = cbm.org_id left join ve1 on contract.contract_code = ve1.contract_code and contract.org_id = ve1.org_id left join ve2 on contract.contract_code = ve2.contract_code and contract.org_id = ve2.org_id left join ve3 on contract.contract_code = ve3.contract_code and contract.org_id = ve3.org_id left join ve4 on contract.contract_code = ve4.contract_code and contract.org_id = ve4.org_id left join ve5 on contract.contract_code = ve5.contract_code and contract.org_id = ve5.org_id left join ve6 on contract.contract_code = ve6.contract_code and contract.org_id = ve6.org_id left join rp on contract.contract_code = rp.contract_code and contract.org_id = rp.org_id left join ro on contract.contract_code = ro.contract_code and contract.org_id = ro.org_id left join tax on contract.contract_code = tax.contract_code and contract.org_id = tax.org_id and tax.contract_type=contract.contract_type left join rbl on contract.contract_code = rbl.contract_code and contract.org_id = rbl.org_id and rbl.amount_type=contract.contract_type ) select contract.contract_code , contract.org_id, contract.contract_type, contract.lease_type, tp.taxRate, contract.client_code, contract.client_name, contract.invoicing_flag, contract.contract_status, cm.financial_contract_status, tp.taxPayable, tp.taxAccrued, tp.taxInvoiced, coalesce (tp.taxPayable, 0)-coalesce (tp.taxAccrued, 0)-coalesce (tp.taxInvoiced,0) as actualTaxBalance, tp.shouldTaxBalance, tp.accountBalance, contract.contract_code_m, tp.serviceFeeReceived, tp.retainedPriceBalance, contract.lease_date_start, contract.lease_date_end, coalesce (tp.report_balance, 0) as reportBalance from contract left join tp on contract.contract_code = tp.contract_code and contract.org_id = tp.org_Id and contract.contract_type = tp.contract_type left join eg_contract_month cm on cm.contract_code = contract.contract_code and cm.org_Id = contract.org_id and cm.del_flag = '0' where NOT (tp.accountBalance = 0 and coalesce (tp.report_balance,0)=0 AND contract.contract_status IN ( '合同结束', '处置结清', '结清', '买断结清', '提前结清', '亏损结清', '已结束', '正常结清')) AND NOT (tp.accountBalance = 0 AND contract.financial_contract_status IN ( '财务入库', '亏损结清', '亏损结清、服务费核销', '入库后处置', '债务重组', '正常核销', '正常核销、资产处置结束（第三方转让）', '正常核销、资产处置结束（第三方转让）、服务费核销', '资产处置结束（资产交易）', '亏损结清、资产处置结束（第三方转让）', '亏损结清、服务费核销、资产处置结束（第三方转让）', '资产出表（ABS）', '资产处置结束（保理出表）', '资产处置结束（第三方转让）', '资产处置结束（第三方转让）、服务费核销', '资产处置结束（内部转让）') AND contract.financial_contract_status is not null AND contract.financial_contract_status !='') and not (coalesce (tp.taxPayable,0)=0 and coalesce (tp.taxaccrued,0)=0 and coalesce (tp.taxinvoiced,0)=0 and coalesce (tp.accountbalance,0)=0 and coalesce (tp.servicefeereceived,0)=0 and coalesce (tp.retainedpricebalance,0)=0 and coalesce (tp.report_balance,0)=0) and contract.contract_code not like '%-1'and contract.contract_code not in ('VL05Z0001')

select epv.*, eoc.org_name from eg_pay_vat epv left join eg_org_company eoc on epv.org_id = eoc.org_id and eoc.del_flag = '0' where epv.del_flag = '0' and epv.contract_code not like '%-1'
and epv.contract_code like concat('%', #{queryDTO.contractCode}::text, '%')
and epv.contract_type = #{queryDTO.contractType}::text
and epv.client_code like concat('%', #{queryDTO.clientCode}::text, '%')
and epv.invoicing_flag = #{queryDTO.invoicingFlag}::text
and epv.contract_status = #{queryDTO.contractStatus}::text
and epv.financial_contract_status = #{queryDTO.financialContractStatus}::text
and epv.org_id = #{queryDTO.orgId}::text
and epv.contract_code_m like concat('%', #{queryDTO.contractCodeM}::text, '%')
and epv.id in
#{item}
and epv.process_status in
#{item}
and
(epv.account_balance != 0 or epv.report_balance != 0)
(epv.account_balance != 0 or epv.actual_tax_balance != 0)
order by epv.id desc
